message.content: {"note_claim": "The terms \"Jewish\" and \"Jew\" are synonyms for \"Israelite\" (i.e., Jew came to denote the whole people).", "label": "SUPPORTS", "quote": "the name came to mean every Jew, wherever he was, without any connection to his tribal origin.", "reason": "The page explains that \"Jew\" evolved to denote the whole people, parallel to \"People of Israel\" (\"the dominant meaning of the word 'Jew' continued to be an ethnic one, in its parallel connotation to the 'People of Israel.'\"), substantiating the synonym claim."}

parsed.note_claim: The terms "Jewish" and "Jew" are synonyms for "Israelite" (i.e., Jew came to denote the whole people).
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: the name came to mean every Jew, wherever he was, without any connection to his tribal origin.
parsed.reason: The page explains that "Jew" evolved to denote the whole people, parallel to "People of Israel" ("the dominant meaning of the word 'Jew' continued to be an ethnic one, in its parallel connotation to the 'People of Israel.'"), substantiating the synonym claim.
